name: Platinum Vape | 1g Live Resin Disposable | Northern Lights
description: Legendary flavor meets effortless convenience. Platinum’s P1 All-In-One Northern Lights delivers the classic indica experience in a sleek, pre-charged device. Each hit blends sweet, spicy, and piney notes with smooth herbal undertones, followed by a deeply calming body high that eases stress and tension. Ready to use right out of the box, this all-in-one is perfect for late nights, winding down, or sinking into full relaxation without the hassle of charging or refilling.
